app.title: Pénates
app.tagline: French property prices, and how reliable they are
app.meaning: French plural noun, said “pay-NAHT”. The household gods of ancient Rome, protectors of the home; by extension, the home itself (“regagner ses pénates” means “to go back home”).

legend.title: Median price, €/m²
legend.priceOnlyNote: Textures describe the reliability of the price.
legend.crossCaption: Colour of each pair of tiers: rows give {{second}}, columns give {{theme}}
legend.crossRough: Hatched: at least one figure is a rough estimate
legend.crossNoData: No data for one of the two
legend.marksThinned: Zoomed out, discs are thinned so they do not overlap: zoom in to see them all.
legend.tiersNote: Three tiers per indicator, from its own legend classes; the place details give exact figures.
legend.riskMeaning: A line marks where the commune-level value rises to the level shown. The data is per commune, so a line follows commune borders and a commune at the edge may be only partly affected. A commune with no data is never counted as a lower level.

inspector.title: Place details
inspector.empty: Select a commune to see its median price and how solid the figure is.

confidence.0: No sales kept in the period. A lack of data does not mean a low price.
confidence.1: Few sales: treat this figure with caution.
confidence.2: A moderate number of sales: a fairly solid figure.
confidence.3: A high number of sales: a solid figure.
confidence.4: Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte: these sales are not in the DVF database. A lack of data does not mean a low price.

inspector.disclaimer: Indicative: median sale price divided by built surface. It is not a valuation of any property.
inspector.windowWide: Period widened to {{months}} months because of few sales
inspector.noIndicators: No other indicators at this level.

sources.title: Sources and limits
sources.method: Price per m² is the median of house and flat sales (one dwelling per sale, off-plan sales excluded) divided by built surface. Land sold with a house is included in its price. Sales are aggregated by commune: no individual sale is shown.
sources.limits: Départements 57, 67, 68 and Mayotte are not covered by the DVF database. The data lags by about one semester.

sources.privacy: No account, no cookies. Only anonymous usage totals are counted (see below). Map tiles are loaded from OpenFreeMap and Cloudflare.
sources.methodExtra: The other indicators (risks, altitude, climate, distances, fibre, rent, land tax, recorded crime on request) are values per commune from public data; an unknown stays empty, never 0. Risks do not describe your plot and do not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL). Climate is interpolated from nearby stations. Distances run in a straight line from a point in the commune to the nearest facility in INSEE's permanent facilities base: they are not travel times. Rent is an asking rent, and the land-tax rate is not the tax bill. Overlays draw places from the same base at their own position (names only for institutions such as schools, hospitals and stations, never for doctors or shops) and seismic zone lines traced from the zone of each commune.

privacy.title: Anonymous usage counts
privacy.explain: Pénates counts, without identifying you, how often pages and features are used: totals per day, with no IP address, no cookie and no typed text. The Do Not Track signal is respected.

risk.title: Risks
risk.note: Commune-level screening indicators: they do not describe your plot and do not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL).

relief.title: Altitude and relief
relief.note: Altitude at the town-hall point (chef-lieu); height range between the lowest and highest points of the commune.

climate.title: Climate
climate.note: Values interpolated from Météo-France stations, not measured in the commune.

services.title: Nearby (straight line)
services.note: Straight-line distances from one point of the commune, not travel times.

connectivity.title: Internet
connectivity.note: Fibre eligibility, not a subscription or a guaranteed speed.

costs.title: Housing costs
costs.note: Advertised rent and voted tax rate: benchmarks, not the cost of a given home.

safety.title: Recorded crime
safety.note: Recorded offences, not the risk of being a victim: figures also depend on how many people report, and swing widely from year to year in small communes.

price.name: Median price per m²
price.about: Median sale price per square metre of built floor area (DVF).

seismic.name: Seismic zone
seismic.about: Regulatory seismic zone of the commune, from 1 (very low) to 5 (high). It sets building rules; it is not a survey of your land.

flood.name: Flooding
flood.about: How far the State's flood procedures have gone in the commune (Géorisques): a flood-zone atlas or the departmental risk file (DDRM), then a prevention plan prescribed, then approved. It is not a measure of your plot's exposure and does not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL). 0 means no procedure recorded, not no risk.

clay.name: Clay shrink-swell

classes.0: soil not expected to be clay

clay.about: Regional exposure map by BRGM: it shows where a soil study is worth doing before building, not the state of your land.

radon.name: Radon
radon.about: Soil radon potential per commune (ASNR, formerly IRSN). Only a measurement inside the home gives the real exposure.

cavities.name: Underground cavities
cavities.about: Number of cavities in the BRGM inventory (quarries, cellars, works, natural cavities). 0 means none known, not none.

altitude.name: Altitude
altitude.about: Altitude of the town-hall point (chef-lieu, IGN), not of the whole commune: large mountain communes vary a lot from place to place.

relief.name: Relief
relief.about: Difference between the lowest and highest point of the commune: a sense of the terrain, not the slope of your land.

sunshine.name: Sunshine
sunshine.about: Average sunshine 1991-2020, interpolated from nearby Météo-France stations: a regional trend, not the shade in your street.

heat.name: Hot days
heat.legend: Days at 30 °C or more per year
heat.filter: Days at 30 °C or more, at most
heat.about: Average number of days per year, 1991-2020, with a maximum of 30 °C or more, interpolated from nearby stations.

heat2050.name: Hot days around 2050
heat2050.about: Observed 1991-2020 normal plus the modelled increase for a France warmed by 2.7 °C (TRACC reference pathway, around 2050). A projection, not a forecast.

rent.name: Indicative rent

burglary.about: Home burglaries recorded by police and gendarmerie (SSMSI), per 1,000 dwellings (not per 1,000 residents).

overlays.intro: Lines for risks and dots for places, over any colour. Switch on as many as you like.
overlays.none: No overlay is available in the data loaded right now. The colours and the filters still work.

notes.risk: Indicative, and never a replacement for the official risk statement (ERRIAL). Every risk is a value per commune, so its lines follow commune borders. No line is not proof of safety: the data may be missing.
notes.places: From INSEE's permanent facilities base (BPE 2025). Dots appear as you zoom in. A dot marked approximate may be a few hundred metres off. Names are shown for schools, hospitals, stations and similar institutions, never for doctors, pharmacies or shops.

seismic.name: Seismic zone boundaries
seismic.about: Lines where the regulatory seismic zone rises to 2, 3 or 4, drawn from the zone of each commune (Géorisques). The zone sets building rules; it is not a forecast and says nothing about your plot.

flood.name: Flooding: State procedures
flood.about: Lines where the State's flood procedures rise to stage 1 (flood atlas or departmental file), 2 (prevention plan prescribed) or 3 (approved), from the value of each commune (Géorisques, GASPAR). A line follows commune borders, not the flood zone, and a commune at the edge may be only partly affected. No line means no procedure recorded, not no risk.

clay.name: Clay shrink-swell
clay.about: Lines where clay exposure rises to low (class 1), medium (2) or high (3), from the value of each commune (BRGM, 2026 map). A line follows commune borders, so a commune at the edge may be only partly affected. It is a sign that a soil study is worth doing before building, not the state of your land. Drawn from zoom 7: in the country view the scattered communes would only read as noise.

radon.name: Radon
radon.about: Lines where the radon category rises to 2 (low potential with aggravating geology) or 3 (significant potential), from the value of each commune (ASNR, formerly IRSN). Category 1 is not drawn. A line follows commune borders, so a commune at the edge may be only partly affected. Only a measurement inside the home gives the real exposure.

cavities.name: Underground cavities
cavities.about: Lines where the number of cavities the BRGM inventory records in a commune rises to 1, 5 or 25. A line follows commune borders, so a commune at the edge may be only partly affected. The inventory is incomplete: no line means none recorded, not none present. Drawn from zoom 7: in the country view the scattered communes would only read as noise.

hos.name: Hospitals and clinics
hos.about: Short-stay hospitals and clinics, public or private. Not whether there is an emergency department.

gp.name: General practitioners
gp.about: GP practices. Not whether they take new patients; no name is shown.

pha.name: Pharmacies
pha.about: Pharmacies, dispensing doctors included. No name is shown.

den.name: Dentists
den.about: Dental practices. No name is shown.

cre.name: Crèches
cre.about: Childcare centres and micro-crèches. Not whether a place is free; no name is shown.

mat.name: Nursery schools
mat.about: Public and private nursery schools (écoles maternelles).

pri.name: Primary schools
pri.about: Public and private primary schools (écoles élémentaires and primaires).

col.name: Collèges (lower secondary)
col.about: Public and private collèges, ages 11 to 15.

lyc.name: Lycées (upper secondary)
lyc.about: General, technological, vocational and agricultural lycées, public and private.

uni.name: Universities and grandes écoles
uni.about: University sites and higher-education schools (engineering, business, agricultural).

sup.name: Supermarkets
sup.about: Supermarkets and hypermarkets. No shop name is shown.

bak.name: Bakeries
bak.about: Bakeries. No shop name is shown.

pos.name: Post offices
pos.about: Post offices, post office relays in shops and community post agencies.

sta.name: Train stations
sta.about: SNCF passenger stations. Not how often trains stop.

pool.name: Swimming pools
pool.about: Indoor and outdoor pools. The source cannot tell public pools from private ones such as fitness clubs: check that it is open to the public.
